title: Marketing Campaign Executive
description:
Job Title: Campaign Executive

Location: Pudsey, West Yorkshire

Salary: From £28,500 per year

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Hours: Mon-Fri, 8:45am - 17:45pm

Start Date: ASAP

About Us

LINK Communication creates effective brand experiences through promotional sampling and experiential marketing.

With over 28 years' experience, we deliver campaigns across supermarkets, convenience retailers, consumer events and trade shows for leading food, drink, lifestyle and technology brands. We are proud to have won 'The Most Effective Retail Sales Experience' award for eight consecutive years.

Our experienced team manages every aspect of campaign delivery, from staffing and logistics to branded equipment and full event experiences.

About the Role

Working as part of our Campaign Team, you will manage a varied range of marketing campaigns and events across the UK, from initial planning through to completion.

This role is based at our office in Pudsey. Applicants must live within a commutable distance or be planning to relocate before starting.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning
- Review campaign briefs, client requirements, deadlines and budgets.
- Agree timelines, reporting requirements, purchase orders, billing details and practical arrangements with clients.
- Maintain accurate campaign information, including staffing rates, expenses, shift times and invoicing details.
- Create task plans, staffing instructions, location maps, equipment lists and campaign timelines.
- Support the recruitment, selection, vetting and briefing of suitable campaign staff.
- Coordinate venues, equipment, print, suppliers, travel, accommodation, logistics and couriers.
- Manage supplier costs and monitor expected campaign profitability.
- Complete venue documentation, health and safety planning, staff training and final pre-campaign checks.

Live Campaign Management
- Oversee live campaigns to ensure they are delivered safely and in line with the agreed brief.
- Monitor activity through photographs, feedback, results and location tracking.
- Quickly resolve any staffing, equipment, venue, logistical or performance issues.
- Provide clients with timely updates, photographs and daily or weekly reports.
- Gather accurate campaign results and feedback from staff, customers and venues.
- Record staff performance and share relevant feedback with the staffing team.
- Keep internal teams updated on client communications and campaign changes.
- Remain contactable during agreed busy weekend periods to support your live campaigns.

Post-Campaign Management
- Coordinate staff debriefs, equipment returns, campaign close-down and the organisation of reusable assets.
- Produce accurate final reports and confirm that all campaign requirements have been completed.
- Complete financial reconciliations and review campaign profitability.
- Evaluate performance and key learnings to improve future campaign delivery.
- Hold post-campaign discussions with clients and identify further opportunities.

Client and Account Development
- Build and maintain positive, long-term client relationships.
- Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and re-engage lapsed clients.
- Keep client details and campaign records up to date within the company CRM.
- Support LINK's social media activity by sharing content about current and upcoming campaigns.

About You

We are looking for someone who has:
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to work with clients, colleagues, suppliers and campaign staff.
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- A proactive, practical approach to solving problems.

Previous marketing, events or campaign experience would be beneficial but is not essential, as full training will be provided.

The position may be particularly suited to graduates in Marketing, Events, PR or Communications who have gained some relevant work experience.

What You'll Get from Us
- Competitive salary
- Paid leave on your birthday and Christmas Eve
- Early Friday finish
- One work-from-home day per week, where possible
- Training, development and ongoing support
- Friendly office team
- Company events
- Company pension
- Free parking
- Sick pay

Please click APPLY to send us your CV and cover letter.

Candidates with experience as a Campaign Executive, Marketing Executive, Events Executive, Brand Activation Executive, Field Marketing Executive or Account Executive may also be considered.

This job description provides an overview of the main duties and responsibilities and is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve in line with business needs, and the postholder may be required to undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Marketing Coordinator - UK and Europe

Location: Bradford, UK - Must live within a commutable distance to Bradford

Hours: Full Time

Reports to: Marketing Manager - US Corporate Office

Are you ready to take your marketing career to an international level?

Join our company, a successful US-headquartered manufacturer with a strong family-owned culture, ambitious growth plans and a genuine commitment to its people.

In this varied role, you will be part of our global Corporate Marketing team, supporting company-wide initiatives while also helping to shape marketing activity for the UK and Europe from our Bradford site.

You will have the opportunity to bring fresh ideas, take ownership of projects and make a visible contribution within a collaborative, values-led business where creativity, autonomy and global thinking are encouraged.

Role overview

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator with a broad set of skills, a proactive approach and the ambition to develop with the business.

The role will involve conducting market research, analysing data, supporting business development activity and regional events, and creating localised promotional materials that clearly communicate how our products, manufacturing expertise, service, lead times and high-quality materials meet the needs of customers across the UK and Europe.

This role would suit someone who is comfortable working independently, taking ownership of tasks, and bringing creative, practical ideas to the team.

You will be organised, curious and self-motivated, with the confidence to work autonomously while staying well connected to colleagues across the wider global marketing function.

Responsibilities include:
- Conduct market research and qualify results to determine potential customers and competitors.
- Help develop and integrate our regional marketing presence in the EU and UK, as well as support broader business development and customer outreach efforts.
- Maintain and optimise customer relationship management database to segment customers for targeted promotional communications.
- Manage social media pages and ensure messaging is aligned with company guidelines.
- Create and deliver integrated campaigns for qualified prospects and existing customers.
- Develop marketing materials for specific market segments (e-mailers, technical bulletins, presentations, and handbooks) and related internal training documents to support best practices.
- Capture, create, and communicate market performance data (sales trends, account status, and website analytic reports) to sales team on a consistent basis.
- Coordinate logistics and sales support for trade shows, develop targeted marketing collateral, and research markets or additional event-specific promotional opportunities.
- Embrace TGC's strong culture of continuous improvement.

Skills and Experience

You will ideally bring:
- Degree-level education in marketing, business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
- Previous experience in a marketing role, with exposure to campaign support, content creation, research, data analysis and internal or external communications.
- Strong written communication, organisation, research and data-management skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
- A good understanding of core marketing principles, audience segmentation, customer communications and the importance of consistent brand messaging.
- Clear written and spoken English.
- A self-motivated and organised approach, with the confidence to work autonomously, take ownership, collaborate with international colleagues and bring creative ideas forward.

It would also be beneficial if you have:
- An additional qualification in marketing, digital marketing, communications or design.
- Experience working within an international business and/or manufacturing environment across UK and European markets.
- Experience with HTML, CRM systems, Adobe Acrobat or other design, email marketing or digital content tools.
- Awareness of local business culture, European markets and basic technical or manufacturing terminology.
- Second-language skills, particularly German.
- A curious, proactive and adaptable approach, with an interest in continuous improvement and developing marketing activity in a growing international business.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a successful international business where you can develop your marketing experience across the UK and European markets while being part of a wider global Corporate Marketing team.

Apply today to take the next step in your marketing career with us

Position Overview:

Elevation Recruitment are partnering with a fast growing e-commerce retailer.

Unlike many online competitors, they design and manufacture our own products right here in the UK.

With a marketing investment exceeding £10 million annually and a growing team of around 300 colleagues, we are a data-driven, performance-focused business with significant scale and momentum. As we enter the next phase of our growth, we have ambitious plans to further expand our digital presence and performance marketing capabilities.

We're now looking for a talented and driven Paid Media Executive to join our team someone who is excited by growth, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to play a key role in shaping the next chapter of our success.

Job Summary

Working across a portfolio of websites, our Paid Media Executive will be a data-driven digital marketing professional responsible for managing and optimising paid advertising campaigns to drive targeted traffic and maximise return on investment (ROI). This will include both Paid Search (e.g., Google and Microsoft Bing Ads) and Paid Social (e.g., Meta, Pinterest and TikTok Ads) to ensure a cohesive biddable media strategy, while working within our business budgets and KPI metrics.

Responsibilities:
- Direct paid search strategy and campaign management in line with company objectives, driving market share growth while maintaining effective sales reserve budgets and PPC spend ratios.
- Managing and optimising campaigns across multiple Search and Shopping platforms, including Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, while driving remarketing and upper-funnel prospecting through paid social channels.
- The right candidate would be expected to manage the above across multiple domains covering both retail and B2 C.
- Manage cross-channel campaign alignment to prevent audience overlap and optimise budget efficiency across platforms.
- Identify new target groups through keyword and audience research, developing suitable new campaigns.
- Build and optimise new and existing campaigns to effectively target newly launched products.
- Lead regular SQR analysis across multiple campaigns, implementing negative keyword strategies and refining campaign structures to improve relevance, efficiency, and overall performance.
- Optimise campaign performance through A/B testing of ad copy, creative assets, landing pages, and shopping feeds.
- Manage shopping feeds to optimise performance through product selection, ad titles, and imagery.
- Develop and maintain comprehensive PPC and eCommerce reporting to support data-driven decision-making across the business.
- Manage weekly and monthly work in progress trackers to ensure alignment with business objectives.
- Providing effectively structured and presented updates into line manager.

Essential Requirements:
- Minimum 3 years PPC experience at either an agency or in-house role.
- A strong candidate will have a keen interest in eCommerce marketing, with understanding of cross-channel interactions and their impact on performance.
- Highly self-motivated and performance-focused, committed to maximising results in line with company KPIs.
- Proven track record of managing and optimising multiple paid Search and Shopping campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.
- Highly proficient with strong attention to detail in preparing, analysing, and deriving recommendations from large data sets.
- Skilled in using Google Analytics 4 for tracking and analysing website and campaign performance

Desirable Requirements:
- Knowledge of attribution models with experience forecasting and reporting campaign performance accordingly.
- Proficient with Microsoft office especially Microsoft Excel & Google sheets.
- Intermediate experience using Google Analytics (GA/GA4).
- Commercially minded with a focus on performance and ROI.
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
- Able to prioritise tasks and manage workload independently.
- Experience managing and overseeing paid social campaigns on platforms such as META, Pinterest, YouTube, and TikTok.

Our small but mighty team is passionate about helping ambitious brands sell more online through tailored, personal service.

Working closely with our Marketing Director, designers and wider team, you'll help plan and deliver engaging social media activity across a range of eCommerce brands, alongside supporting influencer campaigns.

A key part of the role will be coming up with creative ideas that help brands stand out on social, turning marketing priorities, products and promotions into engaging content. You'll be involved in everything from planning content calendars and writing copy to briefing creative, coordinating influencers and reviewing what's performing.

You don't need to be a specialist in every area. We're looking for someone who is creative, organised, commercially aware and genuinely excited by social media, while being comfortable managing a varied workload across multiple brands.

Experience managing organic social media for eCommerce brands would be a big advantage.

What You'll Be Doing
- Planning and supporting organic social media activity across a range of eCommerce brands
- Developing creative ideas for social posts, campaigns, Reels and other short-form content
- Writing engaging, on-brand social media copy
- Creating and managing social content calendars around key campaigns, launches, trends and seasonal moments
- Briefing designers and content creators on social assets and creative requirements
- Supporting the creation of simple social-first content, including capturing photos and short-form video where required
- Coordinating influencer and creator activity, including outreach, gifting and collaborations
- Keeping up to date with social media trends, platform developments and emerging content formats
- Reviewing social performance and using insights to help shape future content
- Writing marketing copy for blogs, landing pages and other digital content
- Working closely with the wider team to ensure client activity is delivered accurately and on time

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a social media, digital marketing, eCommerce or similar role
- Hands-on experience managing or supporting organic social media for brands
- A strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook and TikTok and the types of content that work across each platform
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills
- Confidence developing creative content ideas and contributing to campaign planning
- A good eye for engaging social content and current trends
- Good commercial awareness and an understanding of how social media can support brand awareness, engagement, traffic and sales
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Confidence managing multiple brands, tasks and deadlines
- The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a small team
- A genuine interest in social media, eCommerce and digital marketing

Particularly Useful Experience
- These aren't essential, but we'd particularly love to hear from you if you have experience with:
- Creating social content for eCommerce or consumer brands
- Planning and managing social media content calendars
- Influencer marketing, creator outreach or Shopify Collabs
- Creating or editing simple Reels and short-form video content
- Google Analytics or social media reporting tools
- Working within an eCommerce brand or digital agency

Benefits

The opportunity to work across a variety of exciting eCommerce brands and industries within a growing Shopify Plus Partner

A supportive, collaborative and creative working environment

Ongoing training and professional development opportunities

Real responsibility and ownership - your work will directly impact client growth

Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid working (home-based with two days in Leeds city centre)

Part of a growing, innovative team

25 days holiday plus bank holidays
